description: Find ComfyUI node classes by query, task, or port types. source=local browses the offline knowledge base; live lists only installed nodes and fails if ComfyUI is unavailable; merged prefers live definitions with local fallback. Results identify their source. Use get_node_info to inspect a selected class.

limit.description: Maximum returned matches; total reports the full matching count.

offset.description: Number of matching nodes to skip for pagination.

priority.description: Knowledge-base priority; excludes nodes without local priority metadata.

query.description: Substring in class name, display name, description, or category; omit to browse.

source.description: Node inventory to search; local never contacts ComfyUI, live never falls back.

task.description: Substring in description, display name, or local use cases (e.g. load checkpoint).

name: search_nodes
